Name: Antigravity Vibe Coding
Description: Real-time Google Antigravity agent status monitor & Vibe Coding controller

com.vibecoding.antigravity.status.Name: Agent Live Status
com.vibecoding.antigravity.status.Tooltip: Displays live Antigravity status (Idle / Running / Waiting Approval / Done) and focuses the active IDE or terminal session

com.vibecoding.antigravity.approval.Name: Prompt Response (Approve / Auto / Stop)
com.vibecoding.antigravity.approval.Tooltip: Approve / Proceed (Enter), Auto-Proceed Remaining Steps, or Stop Immediately (Esc / Ctrl+C)

com.vibecoding.antigravity.model.Name: Model Switcher (Gemini 4 / 5.5)
com.vibecoding.antigravity.model.Tooltip: Cycle or lock Gemini 4 Argon, Flash 3.8, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, or Auto

com.vibecoding.antigravity.mode.Name: Policy & Thinking Level
com.vibecoding.antigravity.mode.Tooltip: Cycle Execution Policy (Review / Sandbox / Auto), Thinking Level (Low / Med / High), or Sandbox toggle

com.vibecoding.antigravity.command.Name: Slash Workflow & Prompt
com.vibecoding.antigravity.command.Tooltip: Send /plan, /boost, /goal, /teamwork, /compact, or custom vibe prompts to the active session

com.vibecoding.antigravity.utility.Name: Vibe Utility (Voice / Paste / Hooks)
com.vibecoding.antigravity.utility.Tooltip: Voice Dictation (Win+H / macOS Dictation), Paste Screenshot (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V), Focus Antigravity, or Auto-Install Hooks
